            title="Required">

        <span id="apitoken_csharp">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>API token for quota restriction. Only meaningful when <code>quotaType</code> is <code>Text</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="modelquotaswitch_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#modelquotaswitch_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Model<wbr>Quota<wbr>Switch</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>

        <span id="modelquotas_csharp">

## Import



VOD AIGC Quota can be imported using the composite id `sub_app_id#quota_type#api_token`, e.g.

If quota type is Image/Video

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Vod/aigcQuota:AigcQuota example 1500066373#Image
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Vod/aigcQuota:AigcQuota example 1500066373#Video
```

If quota type is Text

```sh
terraform import tencentcloud_vod_aigc_quota.example 1500066373#Text#<YOUR TOKEN>
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
